metadata.description: Spec-Driven Development Mods for Claude Code and GitHub Spec-Kit.

plugins.name: sdd-navigator
plugins.description: SDD capability UI shell: /sdd, navigation row, view slot, Back/Close and the single status line. Contains no capability business logic.

plugins.name: sdd-phase-tracker
plugins.description: SDD capability 01: phase determination, progress and transitions, derived from the 05 artifact inventory.

plugins.name: sdd-prompt-manager
plugins.description: SDD capability 02: prompt templates, layer composition, prompt resolution, template edit/save/reset and the Prompt Pack catalog.

plugins.name: sdd-prompt-review
plugins.description: SDD capability 03: the sole phase/prompt interceptor and human approval gate before a Spec-Kit phase runs.

plugins.name: sdd-analyze-gate
plugins.description: SDD capability 04: semantic Analyze findings, read-only run guard (best effort), Analyze result state. Execution is delegated through the Review Gate.

plugins.name: sdd-artifact-tracker
plugins.description: SDD capability 05: canonical Spec-Kit artifact inventory, hashes and the single staleness model.

plugins.name: sdd-quality-gate
plugins.description: SDD capability 06: evidence-backed phase gates and the sole owner of Approve, Reject and Continue.

plugins.name: sdd-traceability
plugins.description: SDD capability 07: deterministic requirement ID graph, trace matrix, gaps and orphans.

plugins.name: sdd-convergence-tracker
plugins.description: SDD capability 08: evidence-based convergence state, regressions and recorded exceptions. Requests re-analysis through the Review Gate.

plugins.name: sdd-session-history
plugins.description: SDD capability 09: bounded, project-keyed history of SDD actions. An observer; never writes another Mod's state.

plugins.name: sdd-control-plane
plugins.description: SDD capability 10: aggregate read/delegate view, derived nextAction and configuration view. Not an orchestration engine; owns no approval.

plugins.name: sdd-default-prompt-pack
plugins.description: SDD capability 11: CONTENT ONLY. Default editable engineering-quality prompt templates for Spec-Kit phases. No hooks, no state, no UI.
